user.title: Set up a Smarther thermostat
user.description: The MQTT bridge is a one-time prerequisite. [First-time setup guide]({setup_guide_url}). Enter only the name and device topic prefix; never paste vendor credentials here. Setup does not send thermostat commands.

data_description.topic_prefix: Prefix ending before /device_state. Do not include the /device_state or /set suffix.

error.mqtt_not_ready: Set up the Home Assistant MQTT integration first.
error.invalid_prefix: Enter a valid, exact MQTT prefix without + or #.

abort.already_configured: This MQTT topic prefix is already configured.

init.title: Controls and Smarther panel
init.description: The Smarther panel appears automatically in the sidebar. You can hide this thermostat using the flag below; hiding all thermostats also removes the menu entry. Visibility does not enable commands. Allow commands only after verifying the remote bridge, recent telemetry and absence of competing command writers.

data.show_panel: Show this thermostat in the Smarther panel

data_description.show_panel: On by default. No resources, YAML or dashboard creation required.
